subject: Request: Summer pilot compute + trial extension for University Clinic of San Mateo
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Ruiz <eruiz@ucsm.edu>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: samir.patel@ucsm.edu
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Summer pilot compute + trial extension request

Hi Irene,

Hope you're well — quick ask on behalf of our clinical research team at the University Clinic of San Mateo. We're running a small prospective study this summer (N=150) using de-identified patient narratives to validate a triage assistant. Our IRB board will sign off next week, but our current Redwood trial credits expire at the end of March and we expect we'll need additional compute through August to complete preprocessing and a short evaluation run.

Would Redwood consider a one-time trial extension and supplemental credits for the remainder of the pilot? We are a non-profit teaching clinic and this project is unfunded. We can provide the IRB approval letter and a short usage plan.

Thanks for considering — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Elena
Dr. Elena Ruiz
Clinical Director, Research
University Clinic of San Mateo
[Attachment: draft-usage-plan.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -07:00

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and congrats on the IRB progress.

We can absolutely consider an extension. Two quick asks so I can fast-track to the grants/credits team and to Ben for commercial sign-off: 1) could you attach the final IRB approval (or institutional letter) once it's issued, and 2) a one-page usage plan with expected token counts or GPU hours per week (even rough estimates). That will help us size the supplemental credit pool.

I can provision a small interim top-up to keep the pilot running through the IRB finalization, then follow with a fuller credit allocation subject to review. Ben, looping you to confirm the usual non-profit pilot flow and whether we can push a discretionary promo top-up here.

If helpful I can also schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Head of Education & Research Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Irene / Elena — thanks for looping me in.

We have a discretionary non-profit pilot credit bucket we can apply for cases like this. I can approve an interim 10k-token top-up immediately to prevent any interruption. If Elena can supply the IRB approval and a single-sheet usage estimate (GPU hours or tokens/week) we can escalate for an additional 40k tokens for the remainder of the summer under promo code "REDWOOD-EDU-2027".

Two operational notes: 1) the interim top-up will be applied to the hosted trial account (same billing profile) and 2) larger allocations require a short approval note from our Grants Ops team — I will kick that off once we have the IRB doc and usage plan.

Elena — can you drop the IRB PDF and the spreadsheet to the Drive link Irene shared or send directly to me? If you'd like, I can also set up a short onboarding session to walk your data team through batching and KV caching recommendations to lower token consumption.
